items.event_time_ist: 2:30 PM IST, Oct 14 (issued 2:00 AM MST / 09:00 UTC, Oct 14)
items.summary: NHC Advisory 28 (issued 2:00 AM MST Wed, Oct 14): Simon weakened slightly to 105 mph (969 mb) at 19.8N 107.9W, moving SW at 3 mph - a track-direction change from the near-stationary westward drift of Advisory 27 (110 mph, 965 mb). NHC headline calls it 'compact Simon drifting southwestward'; the monitoring message now names west-central Mexico AND Baja California Sur.
items.title: Simon Advisory 28: dips to 105 mph, drifting southwestward; NHC calls it 'compact'

items.event_time_ist: 2:30 PM IST, Oct 14 (issued 3:00 AM CST / 09:00 UTC, Oct 14)
items.summary: NHC Advisory 4 (issued 3:00 AM CST Wed, Oct 14): Trudy up to 50 mph (1002 mb) ~405 mi S of Acapulco, moving WNW at 10 mph. A recent ASCAT pass repositioned the center farther WSW, shifting the forecast track west of the previous call - the center now expected to remain offshore of southwestern/west-central Mexico, though long-range track uncertainty is large. Rapid intensification still forecast: hurricane within ~24h, major hurricane around Friday; NHC says coastal watches will likely be required later today for portions of southwestern/west-central Mexico.
items.title: Trudy strengthens to 50 mph; track shifts west, hurricane expected within 24h
